# -*- coding: utf-8 -*- import dataiku import pandas as pd, numpy as np from dataiku import pandasutils as pdu from dataiku.scenario import Scenario client = dataiku.api_client() variables = client.get_project(dataiku.get_custom_variables()["projectKey"]).get_variables() continuous_build_message_sender = variables["local"]["continuous_build_message_sender"] if continuous_build_message_sender: scenario = Scenario() message_sender = scenario.get_message_sender("fabiendaoulas-mailer") #dataiku-llm-cost-guard-mailer over_budget_notifications = dataiku.Dataset("over_budget_notifications") over_budget_notifications_df = over_budget_notifications.get_dataframe() not_notified_df = over_budget_notifications_df[ (over_budget_notifications_df["isOverBudget"] == 1) & (over_budget_notifications_df["overBudgetNotificationSent"] == False) ] if len(not_notified_df) > 0: not_notified_df["operationalManager"] = not_notified_df["operationalManager"].str.split(";") not_notified_df["projectOwner"] = not_notified_df["projectOwner"].str.split(";") group_operational_manager = not_notified_df.explode("operationalManager").groupby("operationalManager") group_project_owner = not_notified_df.explode("projectOwner").groupby("projectOwner") for name, group in group_operational_manager: operational_manager_mail_content = f""" Hello {name},

The following projects you oversee are over budget:
""" for index, row in group.iterrows(): project_key = row["projectKey"] budget_usd = row["budgetUSD"] over_budget_usd = row["overBudgetUSD"] if isinstance(row["projectOwner"], list): project_owner = " ".join(row["projectOwner"]) else: project_owner = "(none)" operational_manager_mail_content += f""" Project {project_key}
Amount over budget {over_budget_usd} USD
Budget allocated {budget_usd} USD
Project owner(s) {project_owner}.

""" operational_manager_mail_content += """ Best regards,
Dataiku LLM Cost Guard """ message_sender.send( subject=f"Dataiku LLM Cost Guard: some projects are over budget.", message=operational_manager_mail_content, sendAsHTML=True, recipient=name) for name, group in group_project_owner: project_owner_mail_content = f""" Hello {name},

The following projects you own are over budget:

""" for index, row in group.iterrows(): project_key = row["projectKey"] budget_usd = row["budgetUSD"] over_budget_usd = row["overBudgetUSD"] if isinstance(row["operationalManager"], list): operational_manager = " ".join(row["operationalManager"]) else: operational_manager = "(none)" project_owner_mail_content += f""" Project {project_key}
Amount over budget {over_budget_usd} USD
Budget allocated {budget_usd} USD
Operational manager(s) {operational_manager}.

""" project_owner_mail_content += """ Best regards,
Dataiku LLM Cost Guard """ message_sender.send( subject=f"Dataiku LLM Cost Guard: some of your projects are over budget.", message=project_owner_mail_content, sendAsHTML=True, recipient=name) over_budget_notifications_df["overBudgetNotificationSent"] = True over_budget_notifications.write_with_schema(over_budget_notifications_df)
